title: Daler Mehndi controversy ends as Uttarakhand Minister Subodh Uniyal apologises; Mika Singh’s team reacts
raw_summary:
The controversy involving veteran singer Daler Mehndi and Uttarakhand Cabinet Minister Subodh Uniyal appears to have come to an end after the minister reportedly apologised to the singer over a telephone call. The development was confirmed in a statement issued by Mika Singh’s team, which welcomed the gesture and reiterated the importance of treating artists with dignity and respect.

Reacting to the development, Mika Singh’s team released an official statement expressing hope that the matter could now be put behind them. The statement read, "We appreciate that Subodh Uniyal ji has apologised to Daler Mehndi paaji over a telephonic conversation regarding the unfortunate incident. Respecting artists and their dignity is extremely important. Daler paaji is a senior artist who has contributed immensely to the music industry, and every artist deserves to be treated with respect. We hope this matter can now be put behind us and everyone can move forward with mutual respect and understanding."

The dispute originated at the Siddhpeeth Maa Kunjapuri Tourism and Development Fair in New Tehri, Uttarakhand, where Daler Mehndi had been invited to perform. During the event, Uniyal interrupted the singer from the stage and questioned his conduct in front of the audience. The minister alleged that Mehndi was intoxicated, was not performing properly and was lip-syncing at a religious event being held during Navratri.

The incident subsequently triggered considerable criticism from members of the entertainment industry, with several artists expressing concern over the public treatment of a senior musician. The episode also sparked a wider conversation about the respect and dignity that performers deserve, irrespective of the circumstances surrounding a live performance.

As the disagreement escalated, Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami intervened in an effort to ease tensions between the parties. Before Uniyal's direct apology to Mehndi, Mika Singh had spoken about his interaction with the Chief Minister, appreciating the latter's approach to the situation.

Mika described Dhami as a humble and approachable leader who had communicated with him warmly and respectfully. According to the singer, the Chief Minister had also expressed regret over the incident on behalf of the cabinet minister.

While acknowledging Dhami's gesture, Mika clarified that he did not hold the Chief Minister responsible for what had transpired. He had reportedly told Dhami that there was no need for him to apologise, as he had not personally been involved in the incident. However, Mika maintained that the minister who had interrupted the performance needed to address the matter directly with Daler Mehndi.

Mika also revealed that Dhami had invited both brothers to visit Uttarakhand and perform in the state again, signalling his willingness to help restore the relationship with the music fraternity.

With Subodh Uniyal now reportedly having apologised to Daler Mehndi over the phone, the latest development indicates a step towards resolving the dispute. The episode, which drew attention from across the entertainment industry, has also highlighted the importance of respectful communication between public representatives and members of the creative community.

title: Tiger Shroff’s spokesperson DENIES reports of actor’s statement to Mumbai Police: “This news is completely untrue”
raw_summary:
Reports claiming that Tiger Shroff has given a statement to a team of Mumbai Police’s crime branch following the firing incident on Sunday, October 18, have been denied by the actor’s spokesperson, who has termed the news false.

Some news portals had reported that Tiger Shroff was in deep shock after he was allegedly shot at and had told the police that he did not have enmity with anyone. The reports suggested that the actor had shared these details with the Mumbai Police’s crime branch following the incident. However, his spokesperson has categorically rejected the claims, clarifying that Tiger has not made any such statement.

“This news is completely untrue. Tiger has not made any such statement. No such thing has happened,” Tiger Shroff’s spokesperson said.

The clarification comes amid reports circulating about the actor’s alleged reaction to the incident. The spokesperson has made it clear that the statement attributed to Tiger is not genuine and that the reported interaction, as described in these reports, did not take place.

Tiger was shot at by three people riding a motorcycle on October 18 in Mumbai’s Juhu locality while the actor was leaving a venue in his car. The actor escaped unhurt but his driver and a bystander got injured in the firing. Three alleged suspects were soon arrested after the incident.

title: Tiger Shroff sells Mumbai’s Khar apartment for Rs 9 crores
raw_summary:
Actor Tiger Shroff has sold a residential apartment in Mumbai’s Khar West for Rs 9 crores, according to property registration documents shared by real estate data analytics firm CRE Matrix. The transaction was registered on October 22, 2026, adding to the actor’s recent property deals in Mumbai and Pune.

The apartment is located on the ninth floor of Rustomjee Paramount D Co-operative Housing Society in Khar West. According to the documents, the property has a carpet area of 1,291.14 square feet, along with an exclusive area of 95.80 square feet. The deal was registered at an approximate rate of Rs 64,891 per square foot. The transaction also involved a stamp duty payment of Rs 54 lakhs and included two covered car parking spaces.

Shroff had purchased the apartment from developer Keystone Realtors Private Limited on July 17, 2018, for Rs 7.61 crores. He took possession of the property on November 30, 2019, the documents stated. The actor could not be reached for comment on the sale.

Tiger Shroff’s Other Property Transactions

This is not the first time Shroff has sold a property in the same residential project. A year earlier, the actor sold another apartment at Rustomjee Paramount for Rs 15.6 crores, according to documents reviewed by Square Yards. The sale reportedly earned him a gain of nearly 31%.

The earlier apartment was located on the 22nd floor and had a carpet area of 1,989.72 square feet and a built-up area of 2,189 square feet. Shroff had purchased it in 2018 for Rs 11.62 crores before selling it in 2025 for Rs 15.6 crores. The transaction included three car parking spaces, while the buyer paid stamp duty of Rs 93.60 lakhs and registration charges of Rs 30,000.

Rustomjee Paramount is spread across 1.65 acres and offers two-, three-, four- and five-bedroom apartments, according to Square Yards.

Earlier in 2026, Shroff also sold a residential property in Pune’s Hadapsar for Rs 8.87 crores, as per registration documents accessed by Zapkey. He had purchased the apartment in March 2024 for Rs 7.5 crores, translating into a gross return on investment of 18.3%, according to the data platform.

Located in the Yoo Pune building developed by Panchshil Realty, the apartment measures 4,249 square feet and was sold along with three parking spaces. The transaction, registered on March 31, 2026, was valued at approximately Rs 20,891 per square foot. Stamp duty of over Rs 62 lakhs and registration charges of Rs 30,000 were paid.

Tiger Shroff, son of veteran actor Jackie Shroff, made his Bollywood debut with Heropanti in 2014. He is known for his action-oriented roles and dance performances.

The latest property sale comes days after a firing incident involving the actor in Mumbai’s Juhu area. On the evening of October 18, at least two men allegedly opened fire at his car before fleeing on a motorcycle. Shroff escaped relatively unhurt, while his driver and a bystander sustained injuries.

title: Karan Johar to host ELITE most influential 2026 at Oxford University on December 14
raw_summary:
Filmmaker and producer Karan Johar is set to host the sixth edition of ELITE Most Influential at the historic Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford, England, on December 14, 2026. Organised under the leadership of Puraskar Thadani, Founder and Editor-in-Chief of ELITE Magazine, the event will recognise Indian achievers and personalities from different industries on an international platform.

Known for his work in Hindi cinema, Karan Johar has established a presence across filmmaking, production and television. As the host of ELITE Most Influential Season VI, he will lead the ceremony, which is expected to bring together individuals recognised for their contributions to business, entertainment, fashion, media and other sectors.

The upcoming edition will be held at the Bodleian Libraries, one of the University of Oxford's historic institutions. The choice of venue continues the event's association with internationally recognised landmarks, providing a global setting for the recognition of achievements across industries.

Puraskar Thadani, who founded the ELITE Most Influential platform, has been associated with its expansion across international locations. Previous editions have been linked to landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower in Paris, Tower Bridge in London, the Statue of Liberty in New York, Burj Khalifa in Dubai and the Museum of the Future. With the University of Oxford hosting the sixth season, the platform will add another prominent international venue to its list.

Known professionally as "Mr. Impossible", Thadani has developed the initiative around recognising individuals for their professional accomplishments and providing them with opportunities for international recognition.

Over the years, ELITE Most Influential has honoured or been associated with personalities from various fields. Its previous honourees and associations include television journalist Rajat Sharma, business leader Indra Nooyi, designer Masaba Gupta, entrepreneur Sabeer Bhatia, industrialist Adi Godrej and actor Vivek Oberoi. The list also includes chefs Vikas Khanna and Ranveer Brar, along with personalities such as Kanika Kapoor, Jacqueline Fernandez, Esha Deol, Lillete Dubey and Safa Siddiqui.

The event's previous editions have also had sponsorship and support associations with luxury brands, including Rolls-Royce Motor Cars and Jacob & Co. Watches.

The sixth season of ELITE Most Influential is scheduled for December 14, 2026, at the Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford. While Karan Johar's role as host has been announced, further details about the honourees, attending guests and the programme for the Oxford edition are yet to be revealed.

title: Saiyaara fame Shaan R Grover headlines Chand Mohammad’s Junglywood, trailer to drop soon
raw_summary:
The nepotism debate has been a running topic of discussion within the Hindi film industry, and Reliance Entertainment and Moon Side Films are set to bring a fun take on it on the big screen with Junglywood. Shaan Grover, who became a household name with his role in the blockbuster Saiyaara last year, is set to headline the genre bending thriller.

Junglywood is being directed by Chand Mohammad and it blends dark humour, psychological thrills and twists. It depicts a lot of ‘behind-the-scenes’ situations of the film industry through a hypothetical story. The film also features Akash R Jagga, Irina Rudakova and Deepak Kalra in pivotal roles, alongside multiple fresh faces, including, Dia Singh, Anoushka Chauhan, Niya Bapalawat, Twinkle Arora and other promising new faces.

The director is excited to give an insight into the world of the film industry in a twisted and humorous way. “It’s necessary to know how to take a joke on oneself and with Junglywood, we aim to do that. The film is one-of-a-kind and every second will keep the audience on the edge of their seats,” he said, adding that with the film focusing on the outsider vs insider debate, Shaan proved to be the perfect leading man for it. “Shaan doesn't come from a film background, but he left a lasting impression with Saiyaara last year. So, we thought he would be the perfect person to be the face of our story,” added Chand.

Currently on a professional high, Shaan is seen in the recently-released Tum Mere Ho. Excited about the upcoming project, Shaan said, “Every actor dreams to headline their own film and with Junglywood I am getting that chance. What adds to the appeal is the team behind it. Chand’s vision and the backing of Reliance and Moon Side Films is set to give the Indian audience a one-of-a-kind experience. While I can't divulge much right now, I want to tell the audience to buckle up for a mysterious adventure set to hit their screens soon.”

Junglywood’s trailer will be unveiled around Halloween, offering audiences a glimpse into the film’s mysterious and unpredictable world.

title: Subhash Ghai reunites with Shreyas Talpade 20 years after Iqbal for Manya as filmmaker marks 50 years in cinema
raw_summary:
Filmmaker Subhash Ghai is reuniting with actor Shreyas Talpade after 20 years for his upcoming film Manya. The collaboration comes at a significant point in Ghai’s career as he completes 50 years in Indian cinema, while his production house, Mukta Arts, is set to celebrate its 48th anniversary on October 24.

Over the years, Ghai has worked across commercial and content-driven cinema, with films such as Kalicharan, Karz, Hero, Pardes and Taal to his credit. He has also backed projects such as Iqbal, Black & White and Joggers' Park, reflecting his interest in stories across different genres and formats. Through Mukta Arts, he has contributed to various aspects of the film industry, including production, distribution, exhibition and education.

As Mukta Arts marks its anniversary, the company is preparing to expand its slate with animation feature films, theatrical releases, OTT series and documentaries. Ghai also has several projects in the pipeline, including Khalnayak Returns with Sanjay Dutt and a courtroom drama featuring Anil Kapoor. Further details about the upcoming projects and their casts are expected to be announced in due course.

Meanwhile, Manya marks Ghai’s reunion with Shreyas Talpade, whom he previously directed in the National Award-winning film Iqbal. Produced by Mukta Arts and Puneet Aggarwal, the film is directed by Sameer Joshi. The heartwarming drama follows a juvenile boy from the slums who turns to theft, exploring his circumstances and journey.

Speaking about Manya, Subhash Ghai said, “Working with Shreyas Talpade for this film has been a wonderful experience. He is an exceptionally versatile actor who has demonstrated his range through films like Iqbal, Apna Sapna Money Money and Golmaal. His performance in this heart shattering drama MANYA has once again reminded me of his ability to bring authenticity and depth to a character. This also marks the beginning of more exciting films together as Mukta Arts moves into another year of its glorious journey.”

For Ghai, the collaboration arrives in a year that marks five decades of his association with Indian cinema. With Manya bringing him back together with Talpade after two decades, the filmmaker is also looking ahead to the next phase of Mukta Arts, with projects spanning films, OTT content and documentaries.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Here’s why Aamir Khan has been mentioned under ‘Special Thanks’ in Prahaar
raw_summary:
Prahaar, which was released on October 16, has been appreciated for its subject, dramatic and emotional moments, award-worthy performances and first-rate direction by Avinash Arun. Moviegoers who watched the film were pleasantly surprised to spot Aamir Khan's name in the 'Special Thanks' section of the credits. Bollywood Hungama exclusively spoke to Avinash Arun to find out the reason behind this special mention.

Avinash Arun told us, “I have thanked him because he got me on board. He suggested my name to Mr Dinesh Vijan.” He added, “He told me, ‘Avinash, I think you'll do justice to this subject and I think you should consider this project’. That motivated me to take up Prahaar.”

Avinash Arun continued, “I am really grateful to him because since my first film Killa (2015), Aamir sir has been following my work. Even after Paatal Lok, he called me.”

Can we expect a collaboration between the two? Avinash replied, “We are discussing a couple of things. So, hopefully, we'll work together soon!”

About Avinash Arun Avinash Arun is a renowned cinematographer as well as a director. A graduate of the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII), Pune, he has worked as a cinematographer on several significant films like Masaan (2015), Drishyam (2015), Madaari (2016), Hichki (2018) and Karwaan (2018).

He made his directorial debut with the acclaimed Marathi film Killa, followed by Three Of Us (2023) and web series like School Of Lies, Paatal Lok and Pritam And Pedro. Interestingly, he also served as the director of photography (DOP) on the projects he directed, although Saurabh Goswami shared the cinematography responsibilities on Season 1 of Paatal Lok. title: CINTAA faces contempt proceedings over October 20 elections; Bombay High Court seeks explanation
raw_summary:
The Bombay High Court has sought an explanation from the Cine and Television Artistes Association (CINTAA) over its decision to hold elections and announce the results despite earlier court directions, as per a report by Times Now. The development follows a contempt petition filed by the Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE), which has accused the association of disregarding judicial orders.

On October 22, Justice Aarti Sathe issued a show cause notice to CINTAA, stating that the material placed before the court indicated a prima facie case of wilful disobedience and breach of undertaking. The court has also restrained the association from implementing the outcome of the elections held on October 20, 2026.

FWICE’s petition alleges that CINTAA failed to comply with directions issued by the Bombay High Court on September 11 and October 19. The earlier orders required the parties involved in the dispute to refrain from taking further steps that could affect the court’s directions while a Notice of Motion remained pending before the trial court.

According to the petition, CINTAA went ahead with its election process and declared the results despite these restrictions. FWICE has therefore approached the High Court seeking action over the alleged non-compliance. The federation was represented by Advocates Saveena Bedi Sachar and Ashok Shetty.

The show cause notice, issued under Rule 9(1) of the Contempt of Courts (Bombay High Court Rules, 1994), requires CINTAA to explain why proceedings under the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971, should not be initiated against it. The allegations concern the purported disregard of the previous orders and/or a wilful breach of the undertaking given before the court.

The High Court’s direction means CINTAA cannot act on the October 20 election results or give effect to them while the restraint remains in place. The notice represents an opportunity for the association to respond to the allegations; the court has not yet made a final determination on the contempt petition.

The matter is scheduled to come up before the Bombay High Court again on November 18, 2026.

The Indian Superbike League (ISBL) today announced actor-entrepreneur and one of India’s most-followed motorcycle icons, John Abraham, as Strategic Advisor. The league also launched a high-octane promo film that introduces ISBL as the future of superbike racing in India.

With John Abraham at the centre of its launch, ISBL brings together motorsport, entertainment and pop culture to introduce a new sporting proposition to India. The film marks the first major expression of ISBL’s identity as a sport-meets-entertainment property, built around performance, technology, personalities, competition and India’s enduring motorcycle culture.

Speaking about his association with ISBL, John Abraham, Strategic Advisor, Indian Superbike League, said, "Motorcycles have always been a deeply personal passion. Being a sports team owner has also taught me what it takes to turn belief into sustained commitment. ISBL brings those two parts of my life together. I want to help young Indian riders get the opportunities they deserve and share the thrill of motorcycle racing with a whole new generation of fans. It’s time to Get India Racing.”

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Indian Superbike League (@indiansuperbikeleague)

Pranav Bakre, CEO, Indian Superbike League, said, “I come from a family of racers, so building ISBL is deeply personal. My ambition is to carry that legacy forward by creating something that opens doors for the next generation. I want people to feel the excitement of racing that has stayed with my family for decades. With racing at its heart, and music and culture bringing more people into its world, ISBL is how I want to make that happen.”

Avi Jain, Managing Director, Dhuleva Group and Anchor Investor, ISBL, said, “My passion for motoring draws me to racing. As an investor, what excites me is the opportunity to build a business around it that creates lasting value. With ISBL, our ambition is to build a premium, commercially sustainable league that fans return to and partners want to grow with, season after season.”

Sanctioned by the Federation of Motor Sports Clubs of India (FMSCI), ISBL will operate as a franchise-based championship featuring two Pro categories, Amateur, Female Riders and Rookie classes. ISBL aims to create a structured competitive environment for riders while opening opportunities across teams, technical personnel, brands, creators and the wider motorsport ecosystem.

Further details on teams, riders, race formats and venues will be announced in due course.

title: Anupam Kher to play Sunil Munshi’s father in Swedish-Belgian film Out of Fashion, directed by Jens Jonsson
raw_summary:
Anupam Kher is set to feature in Out of Fashion, an upcoming Swedish-Belgian film directed by Swedish filmmaker Jens Jonsson. Starring actor-writer Sunil Munshi in the lead role, the film follows an Indian-origin fashion designer as he navigates professional challenges in Paris while dealing with family responsibilities in Sweden. Shooting for the project has begun in Stockholm.

The film marks Jonsson’s return to feature filmmaking after spending seven years working in television. He previously won the Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival for The King of Ping Pong, which brought attention to his approach to storytelling.

Written by Munshi, Out of Fashion centres on Armand Kaiser, a successful fashion designer whose professional and personal lives begin to collide. Based in Paris, Armand faces an ultimatum from his fashion house to create an entirely new collection within three weeks or risk losing his position.

His circumstances become more complicated when he receives news from his hometown of Sala, Sweden. His father is living with irreversible dementia, while his sister needs help raising her three children. Caught between his career and his family's needs, Armand embarks on an unexpected journey towards the Himalayas to fulfil his father's final wish.

Kher will portray Armand's father, a character who plays a central role in the film's emotional narrative. The actor has worked across Indian and international cinema, with credits including Bend It Like Beckham, Lust, Caution and Silver Linings Playbook, alongside numerous Indian films.

For Munshi, the screenplay draws on personal experiences, particularly his relationship with his father. The story also places an Indian-origin family at the centre of a Swedish production, exploring themes of cultural identity, belonging and relationships between generations.

The supporting cast includes Bahar Pars, Helena Bergström, Krista Kosonen and Astrid Whettnall, bringing together performers from different backgrounds for the international project.

Out of Fashion is being produced by Way Feature Films and [sic] film, with Beside Productions, Film i Skåne, Film Stockholm and SVT serving as co-production partners. Scanbox Entertainment is handling distribution. The project has also received support from the Swedish Film Institute and the Belgian Tax Shelter.

Principal photography is scheduled to take place across Stockholm, Sala, Brussels and Paris between October and December 2026. The film is expected to receive a theatrical release in early 2028.

Combining the pressures of the fashion industry with family responsibilities and questions of identity, Out of Fashion brings together a story of ambition, personal choices and family relationships, with Kher joining the international production in a key role.

title: CBFC faces reported data security scare as confidential documents linked to over 500 films are allegedly exposed
raw_summary:
The Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) has reportedly encountered a data security scare after confidential documents associated with more than 500 film titles were allegedly exposed through its e-Cinepramaan portal. The reported incident has raised concerns across the film industry regarding the protection of sensitive information submitted by filmmakers and production houses during the film certification process.

According to reports, the documents remained accessible through digital archiving platforms for several days before the alleged exposure came to light. Although the actual film files were reportedly not leaked, the availability of confidential records has prompted questions about the security measures in place to protect filmmakers' intellectual property and commercially sensitive information.

The documents allegedly exposed include scripts of unreleased films, details of cuts and modifications recommended during the certification process, and other material associated with film submissions. The reported exposure of scripts is a particular concern for filmmakers, as the premature disclosure of storylines, plot developments and key scenes could affect projects before their theatrical or digital release.

Additionally, information about scenes that were marked for deletion or modification during the certification process could become publicly accessible. Such details may reveal creative decisions and aspects of a film that filmmakers intended to keep confidential until its release.

What Is the e-Cinepramaan Portal?

The e-Cinepramaan portal is the CBFC's online platform through which filmmakers and production houses submit applications for film certification before releasing their projects. The system facilitates the certification process by allowing applicants to share the required documents and information digitally.

The alleged exposure has raised concerns about the safeguards governing the information submitted through the portal. Filmmakers depend on confidentiality during the certification process, particularly when dealing with unreleased content and material that has not yet been made available to the public.

Distribution Agreements and Licensing Details Also Reportedly Exposed

Beyond scripts and censor-related documents, the alleged incident has reportedly involved private distribution agreements and licensing fee details connected to domestic and international film projects.

These records may contain commercially sensitive information, including revenue-sharing arrangements, intellectual property clauses and contractual terms negotiated between production houses, distributors and licensing partners. If such information becomes accessible to unauthorised parties, it could raise concerns about the confidentiality of business negotiations and agreements within the entertainment industry.

The reported incident has therefore brought attention to the need for stronger data protection measures for digital platforms handling sensitive film-related information. While the actual film files were reportedly not exposed, the alleged availability of confidential documents has raised questions about how such records are stored, accessed and protected.

The extent of the alleged exposure and its potential implications for the filmmakers and production houses concerned remain matters of concern, with the incident highlighting the importance of safeguarding intellectual property and confidential business information throughout the film certification process.

title: BREAKING: Akshay Kumar's Mohra to CLASH with Ranbir Kapoor-Yash's Ramayana this Diwali; Gupt, Tridev, Yudh and Vidhaata re-releases also planned
raw_summary:
The trend of re-releases began in 2024, a year when films like Rockstar (2011), Laila Majnu (2018), Tumbbad (2018), etc. did huge business in their second innings. Meanwhile, in 2025, Sanam Teri Kasam (2016) re-released and stunned the trade by collecting more than Rs. 40 crores, thus emerging as the biggest re-release success of all time. The trend has since died down, though last month, Avengers Endgame: Encore managed to put up impressive numbers. And now, one more classic is all set to return to cinemas – Mohra (1994)!

Yesterday, Trimurti Films Pvt Ltd, the production house behind Mohra, uploaded a video on its YouTube channel confirming the film's re-release. Interestingly, the action entertainer will return to cinemas on November 6, during Diwali week. In other words, Mohra will clash with the much-awaited Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi and others.

Mohra will be re-released by Deepinder Singh's Rimpy Films International in a 4K remastered version. The company's social media page has been sharing interesting updates about the re-release for several days. Through its Instagram Stories, Rimpy Films International has also confirmed plans to re-release other memorable films produced by Trimurti like Vidhaata (1982), Tridev (1989), Gupt (1994), Yudh (1985), etc.

The company further revealed that one of the cinemas screening Mohra will be Heera Talkies in Agra, Uttar Pradesh. Interestingly, the single-screen theatre will play Mohra in all four shows every day. As a result, it won't be screening Ramayana at all.

Meanwhile, Rimpy Films International has re-released Zora (2025), Rajiv Rai's latest directorial, this week. Incidentally, the film is also playing at Agra's Heera Talkies.

Mohra starred Naseeruddin Shah, Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty, Raveena Tandon, Paresh Rawal, Gulshan Grover, Raza Murad, Sadashiv Amrapurkar and Poonam Jhawer. Originally released on July 1, 1994, the film was a blockbuster in cinemas thanks to its mass-appealing moments, ensemble cast, powerful performances and unforgettable music by Viju Shah.

With Mohra being remastered in 4K, watching it on the big screen promises to be a treat, especially for those eager to experience iconic songs like 'Tu Cheez Badi Hai Mast Mast' and 'Tip Tip Barsa Paani' in all their glory in cinemas. However, its clash with a mammoth film like Ramayana could result in limited showcasing. It remains to be seen how the clash plays out and whether Mohra manages to win the love and patronage of audiences in its second innings as well.

title: Fardeen Khan buys his first Royal Enfield Guerrilla 450 Apex: “One of the most fun bikes I’ve ever ridden”
raw_summary:
Actor Fardeen Khan has added a Royal Enfield Guerrilla 450 Apex to his collection, marking his first purchase from the Indian motorcycle brand. The actor shared the news on Instagram, expressing his excitement about the bike and explaining how childhood memories of the iconic Bullet 350 influenced his appreciation for Royal Enfield motorcycles.

In his post, Fardeen revealed that the Guerrilla 450 Apex immediately caught his attention. He also praised the brand for producing motorcycles that, in his view, compete with international offerings. “Proudly taking delivery of my first ever Royal Enfield, the Guerrilla 450 Apex!” he wrote. Fardeen Khan recalls childhood memories of the Bullet 350 Reflecting on his long-standing familiarity with Royal Enfield motorcycles, Fardeen recalled growing up hearing the distinctive sound of the Bullet 350. He said the motorcycles ridden by older boys and Mumbai Police personnel left a lasting impression on him.

“I’ve grown up hearing the unmistakable thump of the old Bullet 350, with its single-cylinder, four-stroke engine. From the older boys who looked so cool riding them to the inspectors of the Mumbai Police Force on their Bullets, that sound was always something else. It’s stayed with me over the years,” he shared.

Explaining his choice, the actor said the Guerrilla 450 Apex stood out to him as soon as he saw it. “So when I saw the Guerrilla 450 Apex, I knew this was the bike for me. I just had to have it. Having ridden a lot of motorcycles over the years, I can honestly say this is one of the most fun bikes I’ve ever ridden,” Fardeen wrote.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Fardeen F Khan (@fardeenfkhan)

Actor clarifies there is no brand affiliation Fardeen further added, “Just to be clear, I have no affiliation with the brand whatsoever. This post comes purely out of the joy and pride of owning an Indian motorcycle that meets world standards, competes with the big boys, and puts Indian motorcycling firmly on the world map,” he stated.

He went on to acknowledge the work of the Royal Enfield team, writing, “A personal acknowledgement of the wonderful work being done by the boys and girls at @royalenfield. You make India proud!” Fardeen Khan’s return to acting Fardeen stepped away from acting for more than a decade before returning to the screen in 2024 with Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s Netflix series Heeramandi: The Diamond Bazaar, in which he played Wali Mohammad. Since his return, he has appeared in films including Khel Khel Mein and Visfot in 2024, followed by Housefull 5 in 2025. He is also set to appear in the upcoming film Raja Shivaji.

title: Yash to handle Karnataka distribution of Ranbir Kapoor starrer Ramayana under Monster Mind Creations
raw_summary:
Yash is expanding his involvement in Ramayana beyond his role as Ravana and his responsibilitis as a co-producer. Monster Mind Creations, the production banner founded by the actor, has launched a dedicated distribution wing that will oversee the film’s theatrical release across Karnataka. The move marks a significant step for the company as it ventures into large-scale theatrical distribution alongside its existing production activities.

With Yash commanding a substantial following in Karnataka and across India, Monster Mind Creations’ involvement in the regional distribution of Ramayana is expected to play an important role in shaping the film’s theatrical rollout in the state. The arrangement places the actor’s own banner at the centre of the film’s Karnataka release strategy, as the makers work towards bringing the ambitious mythological drama to audiences across multiple markets.

Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, known for films such as Dangal and Chhichhore, Ramayana is being developed as a two-part cinematic adaptation of the Indian epic. The film features Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Yash as Ravana. The ensemble brings together prominent actors from different film industries for a project mounted on a large scale.

The Karnataka distribution arrangement forms part of a wider release strategy involving established partners across domestic and international territories. Sony Pictures is handling international distribution, while Dharma Productions will oversee the Hindi-speaking markets in North India. Telugu producer Dil Raju is associated with distribution across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, while Think Studios will handle Tamil Nadu. E4 Entertainment, led by Mukesh Mehta, is responsible for the Kerala market.

Jointly produced by Prime Focus Studios and Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is being envisioned as a large-scale theatrical experience, with visual effects and production design forming key aspects of its cinematic presentation. Yash’s dual involvement as an actor and producer, alongside his banner’s distribution responsibilities in Karnataka, further expands his role in the project.

Ramayana: Part 1 is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on November 5, 2026, across multiple languages and premium large formats. With the Karnataka distribution now assigned to Monster Mind Creations, the film’s release plans continue to take shape across regional and international markets.

title: YRF announces title of Ahaan Panday, Sharvari starrer - Beparwah to release on March 26, 2027
raw_summary:
Yash Raj Films has announced the title of its upcoming romantic action drama, Beparwah, starring Ahaan Panday and Sharvari. Directed by Ali Abbas Zafar and produced by Aditya Chopra, the film is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on March 26, 2027. The production house unveiled the title alongside a teaser poster, marking exactly five months until the film arrives in cinemas.

Beparwah brings together Ahaan Panday, who rose to prominence with Saiyaara, and Sharvari for their first on-screen collaboration. The project marks Ahaan’s second film with Yash Raj Films following his acting debut in Mohit Suri’s romantic drama Saiyaara, in which he starred opposite Aneet Padda. With his next outing, the actor will explore the romantic action genre under the direction of Ali Abbas Zafar.

For Sharvari, the film adds another major project to her growing filmography. The pairing with Ahaan brings together two young performers in a story that combines romance and action, although further details about their characters and the plot remain under wraps.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by Yash Raj Films (@yrf)

The film also marks Zafar’s return to Yash Raj Films, with which he has previously collaborated on projects including Mere Brother Ki Dulhan, Gunday, Sultan and Tiger Zinda Hai. His association with the banner has spanned romantic comedy, action and sports drama, with Sultan and Tiger Zinda Hai emerging as prominent commercial successes. With Beparwah, the filmmaker returns to the production house for another big-screen entertainer.

Produced by Aditya Chopra, the film has been shot across international locations in the United Kingdom and sets in India. Its combination of romance and action places it among YRF’s upcoming theatrical projects aimed at a wide audience.

The March 26, 2027 release date positions Beparwah for a worldwide theatrical launch. With the title now officially revealed, the film has taken another step towards its release, while further details about the story, supporting cast and promotional campaign are awaited.
